capabilities: Draw a segmented progress ring next to each note in the file explorer
Count inline checkboxes and the todo: true frontmatter flag per note
Show a done/total tooltip when hovering a ring
Update rings live while editing and follow explorer folding, renaming and scrolling
extras: Read-only: reads completion state from Obsidian's metadata cache and never modifies notes; folder-level totals are not implemented yet.
problem: Obsidian's file explorer shows only note names, so there is no at-a-glance way to see how much of each note's checklist or to-do is done.
summary: Task progress indicator that draws a segmented progress ring beside each note in the file explorer, filling as the note's tasks are completed.
